submit_info: By clicking the submit button you agree irrevocable that your results can be used for the research purposes stated in the initial consent form. It is no longer possible to  associated your data with you and your browser.
cancel_info: In case you want to take back your consent, this is the last possibility. By clicking the cancel button all data related to this run will be deleted.
thankyou_end: Thank you for your participation. All your data was submitted. You can now close the browser.
thankyou_fail: Thank your for your participation. Please do not restart the user study.
thankyou_canceled: Thank you for your time. All your data was deleted. You can now close the browser.
consent_info: I have read and understood the information above and I freely agree to participate in this research study.
thankyou_welcome: Thank you very much for participating in our study.
study_not_available: This user study is not available anymore.
time_info: The user study takes about 30 minutes to complete. It is not possible to take a break. Therefore, please make sure that you have enough time and are undisturbed to concentrate on the study.
